title: AICP Payment Token
description: Claims structure for the JWS payload of an AICP payment token, authorizing a financial transaction between agent and service.

iss.description: DID key of the token issuer (the agent's signing key).

sub.description: DID of the agent on whose behalf the payment is made.

aud.description: DID of the service that is the intended recipient of this payment token.

iat.description: Issued-at time as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).

exp.description: Expiration time as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).

value.description: Decimal string representation of the monetary value.

amount.description: The exact payment amount being authorized.

maxAmount.description: Maximum amount the service may charge (for usage-based billing).

serviceCategory.description: Category of the service being paid for.

adapterId.description: Identifier of the payment adapter handling settlement.

principalDid.description: DID of the human or organization principal funding this payment.

nonce.description: Cryptographic nonce to ensure uniqueness and prevent replay.

idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key to safely retry payment operations.
